answer: Anchor every agent identity to a stake that is costly to duplicate: each agent locks a bond in escrow, and a random audit committee can slash it if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. A sonnet of praise costs nothing, but a bond is real money - spawning ten thousand fake agents would need ten thousand bonds, turning a cheap flood into an expensive gamble. An ivory tower of trust scores then ranks agents by how long their bond survived audits unslashed, so new identities start at the bottom and earn their way up through honest work.
